title: docs：19.0 正式发布后删掉入门页两处「18.6.0 today」提示（从 #37615 拆出）
body:
repo:objectstack#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibyUSf2nKJWW6qBemSU

Filing gate: ① (b) split from #37615 item 2 by the seat, so that #37615's PR can close it. Source: fleet (review follow-up of PR #37595).
Grading: area:build · Docs · p3 · reach: every newcomer reading the two getting-started pages after 19.0 ships · evidence: grep and npm dist-tags on main 581ae76a.
Dedupe: "18.6.0 today" → only #37615.
Restart-when: `npm view create-objectstack dist-tags.latest` answers 19.x. (At filing it answers 18.6.0; next is 19.0.0-next.2.)

## 维护者速读

- 问题：入门的两页文档各有一句提示，说现在用 npm create 装到的脚手架是 18.6.0，新写法要等 19.0。等 19.0 正式发布，这句话就不对了。
- 修法：等 19.0 正式发布后，把这两个提示删掉。现在删反而会让文档说错，所以这张卡先挂起。
- 要你做的：无。

## Ask

1. Once the restart condition holds, delete the callout in `content/docs/getting-started/your-first-project.mdx` (l.54 at filing) and in `content/docs/getting-started/build-with-claude-code.mdx` (l.56 at filing).
2. Re-check: `git grep -n "18.6.0 today" -- content/docs` finds nothing.

## Acceptance

- After 19.0 GA, neither page tells a reader that `npm create objectstack@latest` installs 18.6.0.
